digest.component_or_area: ChatGPT agent guidance and connector-limited Rebar environment documentation
propositions: ChatGPT sessions may have GitHub connector visibility but lack local clone, Gerrit access, shell network access, or mounted Rebar tracker, requiring documented safe-operation guidance
Existing AGENTS.md and templates do not explain how to recognize connector-limited environments, which operations remain safe, or when native ticket creation is impossible
The only sanctioned exceptional ticket ingest path is rebar import (consuming NDJSON conforming to export.schema.json's required fields), never raw event-file injection or GitHub Contents-API writes

A fallback ticket payload must conform to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id as agent-generated UUID4, ticket_type, title, status) and become source_id on import, enabling idempotent re-import without duplication
Native ticket creation is precisely impossible when both tracker-worktree access AND network/binary access fail; any other capability combination does not trigger fallback

In rebar import --dry-run mode, records missing ticket_id/ticket_type are silently dropped with no warning or counter increment; malformed records are detectable only via would_create + skipped versus total record count comparison
